patthana15.75:1.1: saraṇaṃ savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.75:2.1: araṇaṃ savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.75:4.1: saraṇaṃ avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: cattāri.
patthana15.75:5.1: araṇaṃ avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. saraṇadukapītittike nasaraṇaduka napītittikaṃ
